messages:
Maya: Hey team — dropping a quick mock for the rollout detail panel. Trying a compact 'Variants' list (collapsed by default) instead of the big table. Thoughts on affordance and copy? https://files.mock/redwood/variants-v1.png Tom: Nice. Collapsed by default seems right for long histories. Two quick asks: 1) keyboard focus for the collapse control, 2) visible active variant marker when expanded. Olivia: Agree on collapse. Also can we show the allocation percentage inline (e.g., 'A — 10%') and make the Promote action less heavy visually? Right now the CTA looks like a primary button next to each variant. Aria: Accessibility nits: screen readers need clear state on the group control. Use aria-expanded and an aria-live region when allocations change. Also the color for the "active" pill fails contrast at large text sizes — I'll paste a small example: ```html
  • Variant A — 10%
``` Aria: The Promote button should have an accessible name like "Promote Variant A to default" and confirm dialog should be keyboard-focus-trapped. Sam: On copy: "Promote" reads a bit technical for PMs. Suggest "Make default" (primary) and a secondary "Increase traffic" for staged bumps. Also consider adding a hover/alt text: "Set as default for this model route". design-bot: quick annotation: added an inline microcopy suggestion on the mock for Promote -> Make default and a smaller secondary inline menu for advanced actions (:sparkles:). Tom: UX question: for experiments (A/B) we often have multiple variants live. Should the list visually group 'experiments' vs 'canaries'? Maybe a small tag next to each variant: [canary] or [experiment: pricing-test]. That will help operators triage quickly. Maya: I like grouping. Maybe default collapsed groups by type, and we allow search/filter within the expanded list. Also thinking about mobile — collapsed groups keep height small on narrow viewports. Aria: If we group, ensure group headers are announced (role="group" aria-label="Canaries (2)"), and the expand/collapse controls are reachable via keyboard. Also test the reading order when traffic % updates — aria-live="polite" on the changed allocation node. Olivia: Visual polish: use a left rail small avatar or color bar to indicate variant lineage (forked versions) and a subtle focus ring for keyboard nav. Avoid using only color to convey state. Tom: Implementation detail: when collapsed we should show top-1 variant + a kbd hint "Press Enter to expand" so keyboard users know it's interactive. Maya: Good call. I'll update the mock: collapsed header shows active variant + count, expand icon, and kbd hint. Sam: Can we adjust the confirm pattern for Make default -> show the percentage distribution and a one-click undo available for 30s? That reduces anxiety. deploy-bot: FYI — rollout service supports atomic promote + automatic rollback window (configurable). See /docs/rollouts#promote-api. Added a note to the infra PR to expose the 30s undo toggle. Aria: I'll run a quick screen-reader pass on the updated mock once it's in Figma. Also will run contrast checks and keyboard-only flow. Tom: Action items: Maya update mock, Olivia do focus/visual refinements, Aria accessibility pass, Sam update copy in spec, I'll prototype keyboard interaction. Back in 48h? Maya: Thanks — targetting an updated Figma by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
